import { html } from 'common-tags'

export const registryItem = {
  type: 'registry:ui',
  name: 'timeline',
  title: 'Timeline',

  description: html`
    Displays a list of events in chronological order.
    Supports vertical and horizontal orientations with size variants.
    The reversed prop reverses the visual layout direction;
    consumers are responsible for providing data in the desired order.
  `,

  dependencies: [
    '@ark-ui/vue',
    '@vueuse/core',
  ],
}

export default registryItem

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TimelineOrientation } from '@/components/ui/timeline/context'
import type { TimelineStatus } from '@/components/ui/timeline/TimelineItem.vue'

import { Timeline } from '@/components/ui/timeline'

const props = defineProps<{
  orientation?: TimelineOrientation
  reversed?: boolean
}>()

const items: { title: string, description: string, status: TimelineStatus }[] = [
  {
    title: 'Order placed',
    description: 'Your order has been placed successfully.',
    status: 'complete',
  },
  {
    title: 'In transit',
    description: 'Your package is on the way.',
    status: 'current',
  },
  {
    title: 'Delivered',
    description: 'Your package has been delivered.',
    status: 'incomplete',
  },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Timeline.Root v-bind="props">
    <Timeline.Item
      v-for="(item, index) in items"
      :key="index"
      :status="item.status"
    >
      <Timeline.Connector>
        <Timeline.Indicator />
        <Timeline.Separator />
      </Timeline.Connector>
      <Timeline.Content>
        <Timeline.Title>{{ item.title }}</Timeline.Title>
        <Timeline.Description>{{ item.description }}</Timeline.Description>
      </Timeline.Content>
    </Timeline.Item>
  </Timeline.Root>
</template>
